segments.title: Q turret explosion and the armor lesson
segments.summary: A Q turret explosion follows a discussion of the budget fight between the Kaiserliche Marine and German Army, then ends with a blunt design note: future turrets need more armor.
segments.body: The opening frames the ship design around a budget fight between the Kaiserliche Marine and the German Army, with the army expected to win. The Q turret explosion then shows the cost of leaving the turrets too lightly protected. The first reaction calls the blast spectacular and bad. The conclusion is practical: future turrets need more armor. The clip connects interservice budget pressure with turret survivability and ship-design priorities.

evidence.note: The opening frames the scenario as a budget fight involving the German navy and the German Army.
The transcript reacts to the turret event and concludes with a note to add more armor to the turrets.
